description: 5 exemplars + 4 near-misses + 1 counterexample. Authored with the skill (owner decision OQ-61). Exemplars start from a person, not a product: a hobby, a raw idea, an everyday annoyance, in English and German. Near-misses are the neighbours this skill's When-to-use table routes elsewhere: grilling an existing plan (/challenge-me vision), an internal vision anchor (vision-articulation), an investor pitch for a company with traction (fundraising-narrative), interviewing customers (customer-research). The counterexample guards the word 'interview' in a hiring context.

queries.q: I bake sourdough every weekend and friends keep asking to buy it — could this be a business? Interview me and make a plan
I have a business idea but no plan yet, ask me questions and turn it into a roadmap
every week I lose hours chasing invoices from clients, is there a startup in that? help me figure it out
founder interview: start from my hobbies and problems and research the market for me
Ich habe eine Geschäftsidee, frag mich aus und mach daraus einen Plan mit Markt und Konkurrenz
grill me on this feature draft for the export dashboard until it is clear
queries.note: an existing plan to sharpen → /challenge-me vision, named in the When-to-use table

queries.q: write our company vision for the all-hands: where are we going and why now
queries.note: internal vision anchor for an existing company → vision-articulation

queries.q: tighten the why-now in our Series A pitch, we have 40k MRR
queries.note: investor pitch for a company with traction → fundraising-narrative

queries.q: draft a JTBD interview guide for talking to users who cancelled
queries.note: interviewing customers, not the founder → customer-research

queries.q: design a structured interview loop for hiring a senior backend engineer
